title: can, must, may, will
instructions: Report what people said. Be careful with the **modal verbs**.
hint: can → could · must → had to · may → might · will → would

items.text: Mila said that she {{couldn't}} find her phone.

items.direct: Coach Brooks to Diego: "You must run faster."
items.text: Coach Brooks told Diego that he {{had to}} run faster.

items.direct: Aisha: "I may be late for practice."
items.text: Aisha said that she {{might}} be late for practice.

items.direct: Mr Moreno to Mila: "I will drive you to school."
items.text: Mr Moreno told Mila that he {{would}} drive her to school.

items.direct: Sofia: "We can watch a film tonight."
items.text: Sofia said that they {{could}} watch a film {{that night|that evening}}.

items.direct: Ms Kim to the class: "You must hand in your projects on Friday."
items.text: Ms Kim told the class that they {{had to}} hand in their projects on Friday.
Tyler promised that he {{wouldn't}} tell anybody.
Diego said that Mila {{might|could}} use his laptop.
